description.en: Keep this cell as published. This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. This electric row prints 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical and 60 m³/h. Read it in the Xingtai table. A shared model code on another page does not copy these two numbers across. Xingtai-based Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists Electric 80 at 110 kW, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical, aggregate 24 mm (≤ 2 cm), hopper 0.7 m³, Kawasaki 140 double pump, 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 6000 kg. Keep this cell as published. The model cell also prints HBT80-1816-110. Leave aside move the same condition onto HBT80-16, which prints 110 kW, 50 m³/h, 40 MPa, horizontal conveying 120 m, delivery height 360 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm, 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm and 6500 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. The model cell also prints HBT80-1816-110. Taken from the printed row: The photograph is a working-condition reference from a public article about this kind of work. Keep this cell as published. It is not a Pinjin contract record. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
description.zh: 这是有电网、走管道的建筑浇筑。这一电动行印的是水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、60 m³/h。另一页上相同的型号代码，不能把这两个数字抄过去。邢台河北品锦机械把电动80列为110 kW、60 m³/h、40 MPa、水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、骨料 24 mm（≤ 2 cm）、料斗 0.7 m³、川崎 140 双泵、外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、6000 kg。型号格同时印 HBT80-1816-110。先不要把同一工况挪到HBT80-16，那一行印的是110 kW、50 m³/h、40 MPa、水平输送 120 m、输送高度 360 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管内径 100 / 125 mm、外形 6600 × 1750 × 1800 mm、6500 kg。型号格同时印 HBT80-1816-110。这张照片来自一篇公开文章，只作这类工况的参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
